prerequisites: Successful completion of modules from the 1st and 2nd semesters as per the study plan.
Knowledge in Mathematics, Physics, Mechanics, Electrical Engineering, and Mechatronics, as taught in the basic mechanical engineering lectures.

learning_outcomes.text: Students know the structures of control systems and single-loop control systems.
They are able to analyze the dynamic behavior of linear control systems in the frequency and time domain.
They are able to design controllers.

syllabus_topics: Description of dynamic systems in state space
assessment_rules: The module final exam (Klausur) lasts 150 minutes and accounts for 100% of the module grade. Credit points are awarded upon passing the module final exam. The module's weight for the overall grade is equal to its credit points (factor: 1).
